title: Capabilities Ain’t All You Need: Measuring Propensities in AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model preference for red over blue using a synthetic multiple-choice dataset and estimating the latent propensity via a two-sided 2x2PL Item Response Theory (IRT) framework.
Measuring risk aversion versus risk-seeking behavior using multiple-choice scenarios with expected value considerations, evaluated through an IRT-based probabilistic propensity model.
Assessing the model's tendency for social engagement versus internal isolation using situational multiple-choice questions and maximum likelihood estimation of the propensity parameter.
Testing the model's tendency to answer questions outside its knowledge boundaries versus maintaining a prudent position, using a multiple-choice dataset evaluated with a bilogistic IRT formulation.
